'''Sacorrian grain [[Whiskey/Legends|whiskey]]''' was a strong and sweet [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] drink from [[Sacorria]]. It was popular in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] and beyond during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
